notes: The booklet has two independent models: Speed Racer's white Mach 5 (bag 1, pieces b1-b115) and the Snake Oiler orange car (bag 2, pieces b116-b234). They are genuinely separate builds that share no pieces, so the graph legitimately has two main groups. They are linked only by the shared sticker sheet (b234), which carries stickers for both cars. Piece counts per type and colour match the 234-piece parts list exactly.

Fixed a disconnected cluster in the orange car's rear sub-assembly. The orange plate b149 and the black 1x3 plate b147 beneath it did not touch the rest of the sub-assembly. b149 now also rests on the Technic brick b145, so the group joins the main build.

Fixed tile supports. The orange cockpit plate b128 no longer rests on the studless tile b127; it now rests on the bracket b126 and plate b123. The black corner plate b198 no longer rests on the groove tiles b191 and b192; it now rests on plates b163 and b172.
Minifigure parts (helmets, heads, torsos, legs) are not in the supplied parts list, so they are not recorded.
Stickers are recorded only as the single sticker-sheet piece b234, with no per-sticker nodes.

The booklet shows each step as a rendering. Many 'rests_on' lists are my best reading of which studs clutch, especially where parts are hidden or colours are ambiguous (black versus dark bluish gray). Treat them as approximate.
The white-car cockpit module (b14-b24) and the orange-car cockpit module (b128-b140) are built as sub-assemblies and then set onto the chassis. Their base plates list the chassis pieces they sit on.
The white-car nose sub-assembly (b33-b53) is joined to the cockpit chassis at step 13. This is recorded through b43 resting on b14.
The white-car sub-assemblies drawn in the '2x' box on page 9 are listed as two copies (b46-b49 and b50-b53).
The orange rear sub-assembly (b145-b160) is attached from below. This is recorded as stud joins in other_joins, in addition to the rests_on links of the wedge plates b161 and b162.

Each car's wheels, tyres, bushes and axles are recorded as other_joins: axles through the Technic-brick pin holes, wheels on the axle ends, tyres on the wheels, bushes on the axle ends, and wheel covers (white car only) on the wheels. Bushes are assumed to sit on the outer axle ends: four per car, one at each axle end.
